name: dire-hit-2
effect: Used on a party Pokémon in battle : Raises the target’s critical hit rate by two stages. This item can only be obtained or used via the Wonder Launcher.
short_effect: Raises critical hit rate by two stages in battle. Wonder Launcher only.
